name: BranchDeck
tagline: Keep your worktrees, commands, and terminals in context
description: Juggling Codex, Claude Code, and several Git worktrees? BranchDeck keeps each local checkout, useful commands, and running terminals together on macOS. Find the right workspace, test a feature, and return to your dev server while the app stays running. Discovery happens locally; no BranchDeck account required. Current preview: Apple Silicon, Chinese interface.
status: Not submitted. Public URL, pricing, support contact and Product Hunt sign-in pending.
